---
title: "Analyzing Coded Data"
---

## Analyzing coded data to identify themes or other patterns in the data

Coded data can be used for comparing data across the documents and identifying themes, discourses, narratives or other types of patterns in the data.

### View data for a code or group of codes

One of the simplest analysis approaches to analyzing coded data would be to look at the data that has been assigned to a code.

## Analyzing coded data to identify quantitative patterns in the data

Coding can be used to identify and quantify patterns within the data. In these studies, researchers develop a code book that can be reliably and consistently be used to label the data and make claims about the distribution of those codes after final analysis.
